title.zh: 咖啡机维修手册剖面图

summary.en: Combine a cutaway illustration, numbered labels, a legend, and an exact title block.
summary.zh: 将剖面插画、编号标注、图例与指定标题组合在一页中。

model.evidence: The creator’s parent comparison post names GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and identifies the right-hand result as 2.5; output model not independently verified.

steps.en: a domestic espresso machine drawn in section, 1960s service manual style, fine black line work with flat spot colour on cream paper. Fourteen numbered leader lines, a key down the right listing all fourteen parts, a scale bar in centimetres, and a title block reading FIG. 3 SECTIONAL VIEW MODEL C2.
steps.zh: 绘制一台家用意式咖啡机的剖面图，采用 1960 年代维修手册风格：奶油色纸张、精细黑色线条和平涂专色。包含十四条编号引线，右侧图例列出全部十四个部件，使用厘米比例尺，标题栏写上 FIG. 3 SECTIONAL VIEW MODEL C2。

notes.en: The creator’s parent thread identifies GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and says GPT Image 2 is on the left and 2.5 on the right. This preview links the second source image. This is a creator claim, not a maintainer test.
notes.zh: 作者在线程首帖中标明 GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst，并说明左侧为 GPT Image 2、右侧为 2.5。此处预览链接第二张原帖图片。这是作者声明，不是维护者复测。

notes.en: The English block preserves the published brief, excluding its “Prompt N:” label. Engagement belongs to this individual reply, not the entire comparison thread.
notes.zh: 英文块保留已发布的提示词，去掉“Prompt N:”编号标签。互动量属于这条独立回复，不是整个对比线程。

notes.en: This is an illustration/layout exercise, not a verified repair diagram. The source does not list the fourteen part names; supply exact labels for a real documentation project.
notes.zh: 这是插画与排版练习，不是已验证的维修图。原文没有列出十四个部件名称；用于真实文档时需补充准确标签。
